headline: Keep {arm:September}. Both challengers cost more per reply and degrade character adherence.
lede: {arm:September} achieves the lowest production cost at {cost_per_1k.September|usd} while neither candidate demonstrates improvement on character adherence. A switch would require a candidate demonstrating clear gains on character adherence or lower serving cost.

slots.text: Retain {arm:September} in production. It delivers the lowest production cost at {cost_per_1k.September|usd} and superior character adherence.
{arm:1017} increases spend to {cost_per_1k.1017|usd} with no adherence gain, while {arm:qwen3.8-flash} costs {cost_per_1k.qwen3.8-flash|usd} and regresses adherence.

Weakest margin belongs to {arm:qwen3.8-flash} at {weakest.value|pts} against the {weakest.threshold|pts} limit, leaving a gap of {weakest.margin|pts}. Note reasoning ratios varied across candidates, and two runs of {arm:qwen3.8-flash} experienced dropped trials.
Evaluate prompt interventions or constrained decoding on {arm:1017} to prevent character drop in off lane queries before re-testing.

caveats.material_if: The primary aspect character adherence (v2) was finalized late; material only if the evaluation goals shifted after initial observation.
The control designation for {arm:September} was confirmed late; immaterial because {arm:September} is the established production deployment.
The judge model operates at an undetermined calibration tier; material only if judge bias systematically favors {arm:September} across arms.

method.text: The evaluation ran across {cases} cases with {repeats} repeats per case.
Trials pass when tool constraints hold and the judge marks persona adherence successful.
Aspect readings report ninety-five percent confidence intervals; family contrasts use Holm correction.
Evaluation utilizes {judge.model} under an undetermined calibration tier.
Costs reflect production replicating spend excluding harness and judge evaluation tokens.
Simulator request settings were unrecorded on certain runs and could introduce variation.
Detailed token metrics including input tokens, output tokens, and raw LLM calls were not reported.
